# Postiz Motion Graphics Skill

A catalog of short Postiz dashboard motion graphics clips, organized by product area. Use it to quickly find the right clip for Postiz demos, social posts, launch videos, or product walkthrough compositions.

## What is Postiz?

[Postiz](https://postiz.com) is an AI-powered social media management platform for creators, businesses, and agencies. It helps teams plan, create, schedule, publish, and analyze content across many social channels from a single dashboard.

## Library

17 clips, ~1:56 total runtime.

| Folder | Description | Clips | Duration |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| [`AI_Writer/`](AI_Writer) | AI writing and generation flows | 3 | 0:20.208 |
| [`Analytics/`](Analytics) | Analytics dashboard and growth reporting views | 2 | 0:16.700 |
| [`Automation/`](Automation) | Engagement automation modal and workflow clips | 2 | 0:13.500 |
| [`Calendar/`](Calendar) | Calendar overview and scheduling repositioning | 2 | 0:16.333 |
| [`Media/`](Media) | Media design, customization, and layered generation | 3 | 0:21.542 |
| [`Publishing/`](Publishing) | Publishing previews, refinement, and scheduling | 5 | 0:27.750 |
| **Total** | | **17** | **1:56.033** |

## Naming convention

Every clip is prefixed by the workflow it shows:

- **`agentic_*`** — AI-assisted or automated workflows.
- **`normal_*`** — standard, manual dashboard interactions.

Pick the prefix that matches the story you're telling.

## Usage

- Preserve folder names and filenames when referencing clips from scripts or generated video compositions.
- See [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md) for the full per-file catalog with individual durations.

Full file-level details (type and exact duration for each clip) live in [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md).
